name: no-show-unwind
about: Kai and Lena agree a 2-way trade, a Lightning charger for a desk lamp, and a meetup. Lena doesn't show. The trade unwinds and both are re-listed; that exact loop is never proposed again. When Mo lists a desk lamp, Kai trades with Mo instead.
